# NUMBERS_KEYS.md: the keys of results/final_report_numbers.json

Generated by `python -X utf8 code/final_report/numbers.py` (rebuild, never hand-edit). Writers reference a number as `{{num:key}}`; the builder replaces it by the `text` field.
Never type a number. Formatting of `text`: percentages as whole numbers (`19%`), NSE to two decimals (`0.59`), counts with thousands separators (`1,116`), differences in percentage points (`+32.6 points`),
ranges as `49% to 55%` or `0.54 to 0.60` (lowest to highest single training). The sets of scripts 15-18 and 20-22 are five-seed numbers since 30 October 2026 (seeds 3-4 added after the test scores of seeds 0-2 were known: `seed_note_16`); the stored sets of scripts 02-10 keep three (`stored_sets_three_seeds_list`; see the `n_seeds` keys).
The `source` column names the results file and the dotted JSON path. `note` carries the honesty constraint that travels with the number (fixed wording, 'another split', 'upper bound', PRELIMINARY).

Keys: 12255. Sections follow the report template. The per-set score family (section 7.1) is listed compactly: one row per prediction set and lead; its 22 fields are
`<set>_l<N>_` + `nse`, `nse_range`, `onset_pod`, `onset_pod_range`, `onset_far`, `onset_far_range`, `onset_csi`, `onset_hits`, `onset_misses`, `onset_false_alarms`, `all_pod`, `all_far`, `all_csi`, `all_hits`, `all_misses`, `all_false_alarms`, `n_seeds`, `onset_verdict`, `all_verdict`, `chosen_trigger`, `onset_verdict_chosen`, `all_verdict_chosen`.

Optional E4 keys (present only if the files exist; see the last section) are prefixed `e4a_` (results/warning_policy.json), `e4b_` (results/within_day_inputs.json), `e4e_` (results/flow_state.json),
`e4a_review_` / `e4b_review_` (their review records). Expected names: `e4a_file_present`, `e4a_outcome`, `e4a_outcome_full`, `e4a_status`, `e4a_<set>_l<N>_far_cap_pod` / `_far` / `_trigger`
(the operating point at the GO false share), `e4a_<set>_l<N>_csi_pod` ..., `e4b_outcome_full`, `e4b_<set>_l<N>_nse` / `_onset_pod` / `_onset_far` / `_onset_csi` / `_onset_hits`, `e4e_outcome_full`, `e4e_<set>_l<N>_onset_pod`,
Added 2026-10-29 for the final report: `e4b_<set>_l<N>_far_cap_pod` / `_far` / `_trigger` and `e4e_<set>_l<N>_far_cap_pod` / `_far` / `_trigger` (the test-year onset scores at the level that caps the validation false share;
also `_test_onset_*`, `_validation_onset_*`, `_test_verdict_onset`; the same for the `csi` and `plain` rules), `e4e_paired_<first>_vs_<second>_l<N>_only_with` / `_only_without` / `_both` / `_neither`, `e4e_hourly_basin_days`,
`e4e_fallback_basin_days_24` / `_22` / `_24_test_years`, `e4e_fallback_days_24_test_years_<gauge>`, and `date_e4_reviews` (the dates of the three reviews).
`e4a_review_verdict`, `e4a_review_checks_listed`, `e4a_review_failed`. A writer wraps them in an optional block: if `e4a_file_present` is absent or 'absent', print the future-work sentence instead.

Set labels: `lstm_w` = LSTM, past weather only; `lstm_wq` = LSTM, past weather + river gauge (the rain table alone); `lstm_wf` = LSTM, past weather + perfect weather forecast (upper bound); `lstm_wqf` = LSTM, river gauge + perfect weather forecast (upper bound); `lstm_wn` = LSTM, past weather + NLDAS rain to the evening; `lstm_wqn` = LSTM, gauge + NLDAS rain to the evening (about 17:30); `lstm_wn_older` = control: NLDAS rain one day older, no gauge; `lstm_wqn_older` = control: NLDAS rain one day older, with gauge; `lstm_wqh` = E1: gauge + ERA5 rain to local midnight; `lstm_wqh_older` = E1 control: the same ERA5 rain one day older; `lstm_wh` = E1: ERA5 rain to midnight, no gauge; `lstm_wh_older` = E1 control: ERA5 one day older, no gauge; `lstm_wqh_to09` = E1 control: ERA5 over the rain table's window (09:00 to 09:00); `lstm_wqh_utc` = E1 control: ERA5 over the UTC day; `lstm_wqnh` = E1: NLDAS rain of the issue day + ERA5 rain to midnight; `lstm_wqa` = E1b: gauge + AORC rain to local midnight (an analysis made after the fact); `lstm_wqa_to09` = E1b control: the same AORC rain over the table's own window (09:00 to 09:00); `lstm_wqa_utc` = E1b control: AORC over the UTC day; `lstm_wqa_rep` = E1b: Daymet rain column replaced by the AORC day; `lstm_wqaF_sub` = E2a: wqa + GEFS forecast of days t+1..t+3 substituted at forecast time; `lstm_wqaF_clim` = E2a control: shuffled forecast (measures harm, not information); `lstm_wqaP` = E2a: perfect rain of the three days (upper bound); `lstm_wqF_sub` = E2a: the forecast on the plain gauge model, no rain to midnight; `lstm_wqaF_sub_raw` = E2a: raw (not bias-corrected) forecast substituted; `lstm_wqaF_s` = E2b: wqa + forecast, retrained on the satellite-era split (ANOTHER SPLIT); `lstm_wqa_s` = E2b: wqa retrained on the satellite-era split (ANOTHER SPLIT); `lstm_wqaF_clim_s` = E2b control: shuffled forecast, retrained (ANOTHER SPLIT); `lstm_wq_s` = E2b: rain table + gauge on the satellite-era split (ANOTHER SPLIT); `lstm_wqaP_s` = E2b: perfect rain of the three days (upper bound, ANOTHER SPLIT); `lstm63_wq` = E3: one LSTM trained on 63 rivers, with gauge, scored on the 12; `lstm63_w` = E3: trained on 63 rivers, no gauge; `lstm63eq_wq` = E3: 63 rivers with 5x the update limit and patience window; `unseen50_w_static` = E3: trained on the 50 other rivers, weather + properties: the 12 never seen; `unseen50_w_nostatic` = E3: trained on the 50 other rivers, weather only: the 12 never seen; `lobo_w_static` = 05: leave-one-basin-out, weather + properties (one training per river); `lobo_w_nostatic` = 05: leave-one-basin-out, weather only; `lobo_ref_w_nostatic` = 05: 12-river reference, weather only, one training; `lobo_rf_w` = 05: leave-one-basin-out random forest.
